## Job Hunter Autopilot — setup
1. Create the Google Sheet (tabs: Applied Log, Tailored Applications, Decisions, Execution Log, Errors) — see SETUP.md.
2. Connect credentials: Google Sheets, Google Gemini API, Google Drive, Telegram.
3. Paste your Sheet ID and Drive folder ID where marked YOUR_*.
4. Test with Manual Trigger first. Only then activate the schedule.

## Hard rules (do not remove)
- Paid roles only. NEVER Internshala — it is not in the board list.
- Boards: Wellfound, Built In, Shine, Jobfound, Himalayas, Cutshort, HiringCafe, LinkedIn Jobs.
- Nothing is applied to automatically. Telegram Apply/Skip buttons only LOG
  Siva's decision and send him the apply link + tailored pack.
- Never invent a role, salary, company or email. Scores come from Siva's real CV.

## Memory / learning
The Applied Log + Decisions sheets are the memory layer: every role seen,
every score and every Apply/Skip decision is logged, so the scorer can be
tuned from what Siva actually applies to. No live DB — Sheets only.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 09:15 IST. Manual Trigger is for testing.

nodes.name: Fetch Board Pages
nodes.notes: One request per board. Boards that block scraping error here — the Error Trigger logs it and the run continues.

nodes.name: Gemini Chat Model
nodes.notes: Free-tier Gemini model. Connect your Google Gemini API credential here.

nodes.name: Score & Tailor Role

parameters.text:
=Score this role against Siva's CV and tailor application material for it.
Role: {{ $json.title }} at {{ $json.company }} ({{ $json.board }})
Listing: {{ $json.url }} | Stipend/salary shown: {{ $json.stipend || 'not stated' }}
Reply with ONLY this JSON, no other text: {"score": 0, "fitReason": "...", "resumeBullets": ["...", "...", "..."], "coverLetter": "...", "recommendation": "apply" or "skip"}. Cover letter under 150 words, honest, in Siva's voice, ending asking for a 15-minute call.

nodes.notes: Scores 0-100 against Siva's real CV and writes a tailored cover letter. Never invents CV facts.

nodes.name: Score >= 60?
nodes.notes: Below 60 the role is logged as skipped — Siva never sees it.

nodes.name: Convert Pack to File
nodes.notes: Turns the pack text into a binary file for the Drive upload.

nodes.name: Save Pack to Drive
nodes.notes: Uploads the tailored pack into YOUR_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.

nodes.name: Telegram: Apply or Skip?
nodes.notes: HUMAN APPROVAL STEP. Nothing is applied to until Siva taps Apply — and even then the workflow only logs the decision and returns the link; the actual application stays with Siva.

nodes.name: Telegram Trigger (Buttons)
nodes.notes: Fires when Siva taps Apply or Skip on a Telegram message from this workflow.

nodes.name: Telegram: Apply Link
nodes.notes: Decision logged. The application itself is Siva's tap in the browser.

nodes.name: Notify Siva (Error)
nodes.notes: Error alert only — never sends business content.
